newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy budget package worth 62.5 trln lire - source.
newsitem.headline: Italy budget package worth 62.5 trln lire - source.

text.p: Italy's 1997 budget package should cut 62.5 trillion lire off next year's deficit through a mix of spending cuts, treasury operations and new taxes, a senior government source said on Friday.

He said the package, which is currently being discussed by the cabinet and is due to be unveiled later today, should be enough to cut Italy's deficit to gross domestic product (GDP) ratio to three percent next year.
The source said 25 trillion lire would be raised from spending cuts and 12.5 trillion lire from fresh revenues.
In addition, 12.5 trillion lire would come from a special, one-off "Euro-tax" and a further 12.5 trillion lire from as yet undefined "treasury operations".
